expectedKo: 집의 윤곽과 무늬는 멈춰 있는 구조를 읽게 해 줬습니다. 그런데 발판의 높이가 바뀔 때는 다음 움직임까지 알아야 하죠. 그래서 높이 변화와 캐릭터의 이동을 함께 보겠습니다.
expectedEn: Outlines and patterns helped us read a static structure. When a platform changes height, we also need to understand the next movement. We will therefore watch height changes together with the character moving.

expectedEn: Crossing the flowers required distinguishing platform tops and the destination ledge from the background. Even a retained shape can become difficult to follow when its boundary disappears into darkness. We will examine that problem through lightness differences.
